points.title: 早年生活
points.description: 斯坦利·库布里克1928年7月26日出生于纽约市曼哈顿区的犹太家庭。他的父亲雅各布·库布里克是一名内科医生，母亲萨迪是一位舞蹈家。库布里克在纽约布朗克斯区长大，童年时期对国际象棋表现出浓厚兴趣，后来成为学校棋队成员。1941年，他的父亲鼓励他对摄影产生兴趣，库布里克开始用相机记录生活，这为他后来的电影生涯奠定了基础。1945年，库布里克从威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱高中毕业，但未能进入大学，而是开始在《展望》杂志担任摄影师学徒。
points.descriptionEn: Stanley Kubrick was born on July 26, 1928, in Manhattan, New York City, to a Jewish family. His father, Jacob Kubrick, was a physician, and his mother, Sadie, was a dancer. Kubrick grew up in the Bronx and developed an early passion for chess, becoming a member of his school's chess team. In 1941, his father encouraged his interest in photography, and Kubrick began documenting life with a camera, laying the foundation for his future film career. In 1945, Kubrick graduated from William Howard Taft High School but didn't attend college; instead, he began working as an apprentice photographer for Look magazine.

points.title: 摄影转向电影
points.description: 在《展望》杂志工作期间，库布里克开始接触电影制作。他利用业余时间拍摄了三部短片：《搏击之日》(1951)、《飞行牧师》(1951)和《海军陆战队突击队》(1953)。这些短片展示了库布里克对视觉叙事的天赋和对细节的执着关注。1953年，库布里克辞去杂志工作，全心投入电影创作。他的第一部剧情长片《恐惧与欲望》(1953)由他自编自导，这部低成本战争片虽然获得了评论界的褒贬不一，但展示了库布里克独特的视觉风格和叙事能力，为他赢得了与独立制片人詹姆斯·哈里斯的合作机会。
points.descriptionEn: While working at Look magazine, Kubrick began to explore film production. In his spare time, he made three short films: Day of the Fight (1951), The Flying Padre (1951), and The Seafarers (1953). These shorts showcased Kubrick's talent for visual storytelling and his meticulous attention to detail. In 1953, Kubrick left the magazine to focus full-time on filmmaking. His first feature film, Fear and Desire (1953), which he wrote and directed, was a low-budget war film that received mixed reviews but demonstrated Kubrick's distinctive visual style and narrative abilities, earning him a partnership with independent producer James Harris.

points.title: 好莱坞初期
points.description: 库布里克与詹姆斯·哈里斯合作，在好莱坞开始了他的电影事业。1956年，他执导了《杀手之吻》，这部黑色电影获得了评论界的认可，展示了库布里克对视觉构图和氛围营造的精湛技巧。同年，他拍摄了《杀戮》，这部反战电影通过三个相互关联的故事探讨了暴力的本质，获得了威尼斯电影节特别评审团奖。这些作品确立了库布里克作为一位有才华的新锐导演的地位，同时也展示了他对电影语言的独特理解和创新运用。在洛杉矶期间，库布里克开始形成他标志性的工作方式：对细节的极度关注、精确的视觉构图和严格的拍摄控制。
points.descriptionEn: Kubrick partnered with James Harris and began his film career in Hollywood. In 1956, he directed Killer's Kiss, a film noir that received critical recognition and showcased Kubrick's masterful technique in visual composition and atmosphere building. Later that year, he made The Killing, a heist film told in a non-linear narrative that explored the nature of violence, earning the Silver Lion at the Venice Film Festival. These works established Kubrick as a promising new director and demonstrated his unique understanding and innovative use of cinematic language. During his time in Los Angeles, Kubrick began to develop his signature working style: extreme attention to detail, precise visual composition, and rigorous shooting control.

points.title: 国际声誉确立
points.description: 1957年，库布里克执导了《光荣之路》，这部反战电影由柯克·道格拉斯主演，获得了奥斯卡最佳改编剧本提名。影片通过一战期间法国军队中一名军官的遭遇，深刻揭示了战争的荒谬和官僚主义的残酷。1960年，库布里克执导了史诗战争片《斯巴达克斯》，这部由柯克·道格拉斯主演的大制作获得了四项奥斯卡奖，包括最佳艺术指导和最佳摄影。然而，由于与制片人之间的创作分歧，库布里克决定不再参与大型制片厂项目，转而追求更大的艺术自由。1962年，他移居英国，并在那里度过了余生的大部分时间，开始了与摄影师约翰·奥尔科特和艺术指导基恩·罗曼等长期合作者的关系。
points.descriptionEn: In 1957, Kubrick directed Paths of Glory, an anti-war film starring Kirk Douglas that received an Academy Award nomination for Best Adapted Screenplay. The film profoundly explores the absurdity of war and the cruelty of bureaucracy through the story of a French officer during World War I. In 1960, Kubrick directed the epic Spartacus, a big-budget production starring Kirk Douglas that won four Academy Awards, including Best Art Direction and Best Cinematography. However, due to creative differences with the producer, Kubrick decided not to work on major studio projects again, pursuing greater artistic freedom instead. In 1962, he moved to England, where he would spend most of the rest of his life, beginning long-term collaborations with cinematographer John Alcott and production designer Ken Adam.

points.title: 艺术巅峰期
points.description: 移居英国后，库布里克进入了他创作生涯中最具影响力的阶段。1964年，他执导了《奇爱博士》，这部黑色讽刺喜剧通过核战争危机探讨了冷战时期的政治荒谬和人类自我毁灭的倾向。1968年，他推出了科幻经典《2001太空漫游》，这部影片以其革命性的视觉效果、深刻的哲学主题和创新的叙事结构彻底改变了科幻电影的定义，获得了奥斯卡最佳视觉效果奖。1971年，库布里克执导了《发条橙》，这部极具争议性的影片通过暴力与自由意志的探讨引发了广泛讨论，甚至导致英国一度禁止该片上映。这一时期的作品展示了库布里克对人类处境、权力结构和道德困境的深刻思考，确立了他作为电影史上最具原创性和影响力的导演之一的地位。
points.descriptionEn: After moving to England, Kubrick entered the most influential phase of his career. In 1964, he directed Dr. Strangelove, a black comedy that explores the absurdity of Cold War politics and humanity's self-destructive tendencies through a nuclear crisis. In 1968, he released 2001: A Space Odyssey, a science fiction classic that revolutionized the genre with its groundbreaking visuals, philosophical themes, and innovative narrative structure, winning the Academy Award for Best Visual Effects. In 1971, Kubrick directed A Clockwork Orange, a highly controversial film that sparked widespread debate through its exploration of violence and free will, leading to its temporary banning in the UK. This period's works demonstrated Kubrick's profound thinking on human condition, power structures, and moral dilemmas, establishing him as one of the most original and influential directors in film history.

points.title: 晚期创作
points.description: 1970年代至1990年代，库布里克继续创作了一系列具有深远影响的作品。1975年，他执导了《巴里·林登》，这部18世纪背景的影片以其精湛的摄影和构图获得了奥斯卡最佳摄影和最佳艺术指导奖。1980年，他推出了恐怖经典《闪灵》，这部改编自斯蒂芬·金小说的影片通过心理恐怖元素重新定义了恐怖片类型。1987年，库布里克执导了《全金属外壳》，这部越战题材影片通过两个截然不同的段落探讨了战争对人性的摧残。1997年，他完成了最后一部作品《大开眼戒》，这部神秘主义色彩浓厚的影片探讨了婚姻、欲望和人性秘密。库布里克以其对细节的极致追求、对拍摄条件的严格控制和对电影语言的不断创新而闻名。他一生只完成了13部长片，但每一部都对电影艺术产生了深远影响，使他成为电影史上最具神秘感和影响力的导演之一。
points.descriptionEn: From the 1970s to the 1990s, Kubrick continued to create a series of profoundly influential works. In 1975, he directed Barry Lyndon, an 18th-century period film that won Academy Awards for Best Cinematography and Best Art Direction for its exquisite photography and composition. In 1980, he released The Shining, a horror classic that redefined the genre through its psychological terror elements, adapted from Stephen King's novel. In 1987, Kubrick directed Full Metal Jacket, a Vietnam War film that explores the destruction of human nature through war, divided into two distinct segments. In 1997, he completed his final work, Eyes Wide Shut, a film with strong mystical undertones that explores marriage, desire, and human secrets. Kubrick was known for his extreme attention to detail, rigorous control over production conditions, and continuous innovation in cinematic language. He completed only 13 feature films in his lifetime, but each had a profound impact on the art of cinema, establishing him as one of the most enigmatic and influential directors in film history.

appraisal.zh: 库布里克被公认为电影艺术的革新者与作者导演的典范，其视觉风格、技术实验与哲学思辨把电影提升为严肃艺术形式，作品至今被广泛研究。不过也有研究者指出，他的影片常显情感疏离、形式重于人物，女性角色缺乏深度，个别作品带有刻板印象，完美主义的工作方式亦造成关系紧张与超支。尽管后期作品被部分论者视为自我重复，他仍是电影史上最具神秘感与影响力的人物之一。
appraisal.en: Kubrick is widely recognized as an innovator of cinematic art and a model auteur, whose visual style, technical experimentation and philosophical reflection elevated film to a serious art form; his works remain widely studied. Yet some researchers note his films can feel emotionally detached, privileging form over character, with female roles lacking depth, occasional stereotypes, and a perfectionism that strained relations and budgets. Though some view his later work as self-repetitive, he remains one of film history's most enigmatic and influential figures.

supporter.zh: 库布里克被视为电影史上最具创新精神和艺术追求的导演之一。他的作品以其独特的视觉风格、深刻的哲学思考和精湛的电影技术而著称。支持者认为库布里克通过电影艺术探索了人类存在的根本问题，包括暴力、权力、自由意志和道德困境。他对细节的极致追求和对电影语言的不断创新，为后来的电影人树立了极高的艺术标准。库布里克的作品超越了时代限制，至今仍被广泛研究和分析，他的遗产在于证明了电影不仅可以作为娱乐工具，更可以作为严肃的艺术形式，探索复杂的思想和情感。
supporter.en: Kubrick is regarded as one of the most innovative and artistically ambitious directors in film history. His works are celebrated for their distinctive visual style, profound philosophical thinking, and masterful cinematic technique. Supporters argue that Kubrick explored fundamental questions of human existence through his films, including violence, power, free will, and moral dilemmas. His extreme attention to detail and continuous innovation in cinematic language set exceptionally high artistic standards for future filmmakers. Kubrick's works have transcended their time and continue to be widely studied and analyzed. His legacy lies in demonstrating that film can serve not merely as entertainment but as a serious art form capable of exploring complex ideas and emotions.

critic.zh: 批评者认为库布里克的作品存在明显的局限性。首先，他的电影常常被指责为情感疏离，过于注重形式而忽视人物情感的真实性。其次，库布里克对女性角色的塑造常受到批评，认为他的女性角色往往缺乏深度，沦为男性角色的附属品或象征符号。此外，一些评论家指出库布里克的作品中存在种族和文化的刻板印象，如《发条橙》中对英国工人阶级的描绘。他的完美主义工作方式也被批评为与演员和工作人员关系紧张，导致项目延期和预算超支。最后，一些批评者认为库布里克后期作品过于自我重复，缺乏早期作品的创新性和社会批判力度。
critic.en: Critics point out several limitations in Kubrick's work. First, his films are often accused of emotional detachment, prioritizing form over authentic character development. Second, Kubrick's portrayal of female characters has faced criticism for lacking depth, often reducing them to appendages or symbolic representations of male characters. Additionally, some commentators note racial and cultural stereotypes in his work, such as the depiction of the British working class in A Clockwork Orange. His perfectionist work style has also been criticized for creating tense relationships with actors and crew, leading to production delays and budget overruns. Finally, some critics argue that Kubrick's later works became self-repetitive, lacking the innovation and social critique of his earlier films.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，库布里克被定义为电影艺术的革新者和电影语言的探索者。他的作品被广泛认为是作者导演的典范，体现了导演个人艺术视野的完整性。库布里克对电影技术的影响深远，特别是在摄影、音效和视觉特效方面的创新。他的电影如《2001太空漫游》和《闪灵》已成为流行文化的重要符号，被不断引用和致敬。在电影学术界，库布里克被视为将电影从单纯的叙事媒介提升为艺术形式的关键人物。他的创作生涯虽然作品数量不多，但每一部都经过精心打磨，体现了对电影艺术的极致追求，使他成为电影史上最具神秘感和影响力的导演之一。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture contexts, Kubrick is defined as an innovator of cinematic art and an explorer of film language. His works are widely regarded as exemplars of the auteur director, embodying the integrity of a director's personal artistic vision. Kubrick's influence on film technology has been profound, particularly his innovations in cinematography, sound design, and visual effects. His films like 2001: A Space Odyssey and The Shining have become significant cultural symbols, constantly referenced and homaged. In film academia, Kubrick is seen as a key figure who elevated film from a mere narrative medium to an art form. Though his filmography is small, each work was meticulously crafted, reflecting his extreme pursuit of cinematic art, establishing him as one of the most enigmatic and influential directors in film history.

self.zh: 如果一个人有足够的勇气，他可以独自完成任何事情。
self.en: If one has the courage to say it, one can do anything.
